Definition: the thigh (from its fleshy softness); by euphemistically the generative parts; figuratively, a shank, flank, side
BiblicalUsage: 1) thigh, side, loin, base; 1a) thigh; 1a1) outside of thigh (where sword was worn); 1a2) loins (as the seat of procreative power); 1b) side (flank) (of object); 1c) base
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
